title: Linear Control Systems Laboratory
objectives:
The objective of this lab is to allow students to devise simple logic circuits, hence giving them an opportunity to
reinforce the theoretical concepts taught in the course “Linear Control Systems”.
syllabus: The experiments cover relevant topics prescribed in the syllabus.
textbooks:
1. Uday A. Bakshi, "Linear Control Systems", 2007.
2. Richard C. Dorf, Robert H. Bishop, "Modern Control Systems", 2010.
3. K. Ogata, Modern Centeral Engineering, 5th ed. Prentice – Hall, 2009.
